about.heading: About the project
about.paragraph1: Dev.Sack was born from a simple frustration: spending more time searching for the right tool than actually building with it.
about.paragraph2: This project exists to save the developer community those hours of searching, bringing together quality tools, platforms, and resources in one place — hand-curated, with no noise and no filler.
